claims.text: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort is a 15-acre retreat in Wailea, Maui, with direct access to Mokapu Beach.

findings.quote: Andaz Maui at Wailea Resort, a 15-acre retreat in Wailea, Maui with direct access to Mokapu Beach

claims.text: The resort is design-forward and inspired by the Hawaiian beach house aesthetic.

findings.quote: A sleek, design-forward resort inspired by the Hawaiian beach house aesthetic

findings.quote: Neutral color palettes and wood furnishings let the tropical location and Pacific Ocean views take center stage.
